answer: An agent economy can anchor identity to a physical wharf by requiring each participant to bond capital against a hardware-rooted attestation, so a single island of verified stake maps to one registered agent. Sybil clusters that wander across forged keys are detected when their bond provenance fails cross-chain reconciliation, collapsing their effective weight to the honest quorum. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
